Does an artists's personal life have any impact on whether or not you enjoy their work?

Not really. I try not to look into an artist's personal life. I feel it ruins the purity of their work if I add a face or an additional story to it. That being said, sometimes I do find out things about an artist's life and it does hang around in the back of my mind when I see their work and I feel it changes my thoughts on it, even if it's just a little.
